**Nexo 1.3.2** lets you pick your own accent color, and the app icon you choose now shows on the taskbar. Nexo
updates itself: look for the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** no server update needed; servers on v1.3.0 or later work with this version.

## New

- **Custom accent color:** in **Settings → Appearance → Accent**, the last swatch opens a color picker. Pick
  any color or type its hex code. Nexo makes it a little lighter in dark themes or darker in the light theme
  when it would be hard to read. The Accent and Paper app icons use it too.

## Fixes

- **App icon on the taskbar:** the icon you pick in **Settings → Appearance → App icon** now also changes
  Nexo's Start menu, desktop and taskbar shortcuts. The taskbar shows it the next time you start Nexo.
- **Title bar:** the logo in the top-left corner now shows the app icon you picked.
- **Accent swatches:** the Mint swatch showed the color of whatever accent was selected.

## Install

Already on Nexo? Nothing to do: it updates itself.

On a **test build**? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo. Test
builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
